format: snug conformance corpus v1. Each suite: cddl text, profile (full unless stated), cases [{rule, hex, expect: true|false, reason?, note?}]. A suite with schemaError expects compile to fail with that code. phase:"later" suites are not yet gated.
source: Independent RFC 8610 / RFC 9682 oracle; reviews C1-C22 and A1-A14; deterministic seed 0x5eed8610
notes: snugSchemaError marks an architecture revision 2 refusal, not an RFC parse error. Such suites still have oracle verdicts.
All hex values decode under the strict baseline profile. Scalar -0, infinities and NaN have no profile value; -0 is exercised inside typed arrays.
Prelude types whose only inhabitants use forbidden tags/simple values cannot have profile-valid accept cases; their suites explicitly document this.
Non-random cases are checked against hand-reasoned verdicts in export-adversarial.mjs. Random expectations come only from the oracle; no snug output is used.
